summary.text: Becca Ripley is the Democratic candidate for Tennessee House of Representatives District 61 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces incumbent Republican Gino Bulso.
Ripley advanced from the Democratic primary on August 6, 2026, with 3,605 votes and no opponent on the ballot.
